title: Hotel platform netaffinity / SmartHotel reportedly confirms security incident after guests get WhatsApp phishing
date_note: Borns IT-Blog, published 23 November, gives no earlier public report; the blog cites a consultant's account that the incident was known since 14 November.
geo_basis: Borns IT-Blog says the provider is reportedly based in the Netherlands; country-level pin
summary: Borns IT-Blog reports that hotel guests who booked via a hotel's website received WhatsApp phishing messages containing real booking data. According to an IT consultant's account, netaffinity first said an incident of unknown scope was under investigation, then confirmed a security incident. The blog says no official details have been published; the company told the press it does not comment.
plain: Hotel guests got WhatsApp scam messages with real booking details. A booking platform reportedly confirmed a security incident, but gave no details.
exec: A hospitality software provider reportedly had a security incident; guests of its hotel customers received phishing with real booking data.
impact: Scope not stated; the blog notes a possible data outflow.

validation.note: Only Borns IT-Blog read; it relays an IT consultant's account. No statement from netaffinity or SmartHotel was found.

review.note: place: blog says provider reportedly based in the Netherlands; pin moved from Germany. Rest matches the blog.
